scope: Current people behavior examples. Fixture names are stable labels, not prescribed internal API types. One group may be proven by one table-driven test. Named subcases share the parent case ID; all their effects must be checked.

cases.requirement: Stage movement preserves soft warnings, reason and chronology
cases.description: Person Contact with unmet recorded interview warning; second Person already Leader

utterances: Review explicit forward move with acknowledged warnings; record later interview on Leader

checks: Chosen Person moves once with reason/history; Leader stays Leader; no inferred demotion
Member cannot move another Person; name ambiguity produces no proposal
Changed stage revision refuses; replay adds no duplicate stage event

cases.requirement: Tags remain plant-defined and independently assignable
cases.description: Tag northside in plant-A; same name in plant-B; Person has existing tag family

utterances: Create/update then assign/remove northside via exact reviewed operations

checks: Only selected tag definition/Person links change; other tag links survive
Foreign tag/person IDs unavailable without existence; Member mutation denied
Concurrent duplicate tag key conflicts safely; stale update does not overwrite

cases.requirement: Skills and proficiency remain distinct from certification
cases.description: Alex has hospitality basic and music advanced; category labels overlap

utterances: Review update hospitality proficiency then remove only that skill

checks: Music skill/category stays; no certification/background-check fields or claims
Foreign skill and background-check filter rejected
Stale skill version refuses with current safe reread; no partial mutation

cases.requirement: Human four-Cs ratings, latest and history remain exact
cases.description: Alex has two dated approved four-Cs records; Admin and Member accounts

utterances: Admin records third exact criteria-version ratings and reads history

checks: Latest is selected by accepted event chronology; all three records retained; no model-generated spiritual judgment
Member/org/assistant pastoral suitability inference denied; Admin full approved read succeeds
Invalid ratings or foreign person leaves no assessment/stage/history

cases.requirement: Five-criterion interviews preserve result and next steps
cases.description: Alex Prospect; advanced Casey Leader; approved interview criteria version

utterances: Admin records interview with result and exact next steps on both

checks: Records retained; qualifying forward transition may advance Alex; Casey stays advanced; event date differs from entry date
Member and organization cannot read full interview; model cannot decide pastoral fitness
Corrected/stale interview revision refuses or uses typed correction; no duplicate interview on replay

cases.requirement: Commitment links private bytes, adult classification and genuine first acquisition
cases.description: Alex classified adult with no commitment; Casey classified minor; original attachment staged to Admin+plant

utterances: Review dated actual commitment with attachment, then withdraw and reactivate Alex

checks: Alex current committed cohort removes on withdrawal and restores on rejoin; genuine original acquisition date remains; rejoin adds no new acquisition; Casey not adult denominator
Foreign attachment/Person/witness rejects; Member/org cannot read private commitment intake
Attachment digest/expiry mismatch prevents commit; lost response replays one commitment and one file bind

cases.requirement: Recorded events advance only approved chronology
cases.description: Contact Alex invited but not attended; Casey already Leader; first actual Vision attendance and team assignment fixtures

utterances: Finalize actual attendance then assign team role through shared domain tx

checks: RSVP/invitation alone never advances; actual evidence preserves advanced stage; one event receipt per cause
No actorless event invocation or manual title grants
Fault between attendance and induced event rolls back all required domain effects

cases.requirement: Incomplete source follow-up helper grants no invisible effect
cases.description: One Person has no follow-up task; source handleFollowUpInitiated has no functioning caller

utterances: Read follow-up coverage; explicitly review native task creation separately

checks: Read reports unassigned/missing work; review creates one real task/obligation; no automatic outreach from nonexistent source helper
Helper ID cannot bypass task authority/review
Failed task creation leaves no fake contact event or completion evidence

cases.requirement: Internal recorded pipeline metrics preserve windows, deduplication and Unknown
cases.description: Window contains Alex duplicated recruitment-source events, Casey observed stage transition and Jamie unknown source; second window denominator0

utterances: Authorized native internal caller invokes people.readPipelineMetrics; model asks for nonexistent new analytics tool

checks: Window deduplicates eligible persons; actual recorded transition/source counts exact; missing source separately Unknown; denominator0 ratio Unknown; no new widget/tool
Foreign plant/internal actorless call denied; no org raw-person/model analytics grant
Missing recorded chronology returns unavailable/Unknown, no fabricated baseline or conversion denominator

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-001
cases.description: 25 People with equal createdAt; AND 2 tags; search literal%/_; retired and foreign cursor; switch card/filter/load more; unresolved adult classification.

checks: No duplicates/skips/leaks; URL filters roundtrip, active set excludes retired and uncertainty appears without DOB guess.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-002
cases.description: Whitespace name, single-name Launch guest, nullable clear, forged account/storage key, valid partial address; request background field.

checks: Real name and nullable clear work; blank or forged/excluded field denied, no fabricated identity/grant/qualification appears.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-003
cases.description: Retire assigned Person and concurrently insert attendance; restore ordinary retired versus merged source; foreign ID.

checks: No current new reference escapes retirement, history survives, duties remain visible and merged source cannot resurrect outside Unmerge.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-004
cases.description: Two active unlinked same-email contacts; linked contact email changed; concurrent accept; removed seat; Owner with and without actual commitment.

checks: One stable link per account/plant, ambiguity requires explicit review, no authority is stolen and metrics use the correct cohort.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-005
cases.description: Foreign/retired Person; failed save and cleanup; replace cached photo; merge chooses source photo and safe inverse.

checks: Authorized versioned photo works, no raw key escapes and referenced merge/source bytes remain usable.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-006
cases.description: Skip prospect→leader, backward leader→at ten dee, same-stage retry, concurrent edits and declined open-duty handoff.

checks: Warnings and attributable history persist, explicit demotion works, decline keeps Needs owner and other lifecycles do not change implicitly.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-007
cases.description: All 7 stages; foreign ID reorder; stale column order; completed/waived/overdue/undated task and uncovered sans duty.

checks: Exact 5 columns and milestone badges; current actionable warnings only, no invisible foreign reorder or automatic urgency.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-008
cases.description: 3 activities at one instant; author A/B; forged personId with valid note ID; edit and delete; ordinary audit row.

checks: All timeline entries paginate, exact author/Person scope holds, correction/tombstone explains change and immutable events refuse edit.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-009
cases.description: Person retired while household create; concurrent join/delete; own meaningful address versus blank; preview propagation then stale edit; empty with retired history.

checks: No orphans/cross tenant links; joining/leaving address rules hold, stale bulk refuses all and history does not block safe empty delete.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-010
cases.description: Foreign tag/Person; same-name race; repeated assign/remove; nullable color; linked tag delete.

checks: One owned label/link semantic result, no false events and linked views/export follow renames with audited deletion.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-011
cases.description: Every enum/null clear; foreign skill ID; stale edit/remove; role qualification record referencing historical skill.

checks: Valid recorded skills group correctly, revision/history holds and removal neither rewrites interview nor creates AI judgment.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-012
cases.description: Four 1/5 scores+forged total; same/out of order dates; prospect assessment; Member/org read; corrected historical score.

checks: Computed totals/latest history correct, human provenance intact, early warning advisory and full record is Owner/Admin only.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-013
cases.description: Each 4 results on prospect and advanced leader; backdated repeat interview; fail activity write; text next step without task review.

checks: All human criteria/results persist with correct history; earlier person advances as interview occurred, advanced person never regresses and no task appears without explicit command.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-014
cases.description: 10 MiB valid file and failed commit; foreign witness; repeat launch-team card on leader; withdrawal then reactivation; historical signed date.

checks: Private bytes/owned witness safe, coherent record/lifecycle with advanced stage preserved and genuine first occurrence unchanged by recording/rejoin.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-015
cases.description: Same-record two corrections, foreign Person with known record ID, forged total/provenance, invalid first event correction, attempted original document/witness replacement.

checks: One version wins and history matches current state; invalid facts recompute without stage demotion or rewriting authorship, opaque unsafe changes refuse.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-016
cases.description: Blank/short/wildcard input, email casing/phone format, same family name/shared mailbox, foreign/retired candidate.

checks: Documented hints are bounded scoped and non binding; intentional duplicates allowed with no automatic merge.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-017
cases.description: Conflicting attendance/card/training/RSVP/follow-up and two accounts; safe unchanged merge+inverse; stale/chained/irreversible effects; later consumer registration.

checks: Every blocked collision refuses atomically; safe inverse is usable both native/Evry, receipts/history remain, later conflict returns exact reason and zero changes.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-018
cases.description: CSV multiline/BOM/bad quote/formula; existing and within-file duplicates; 3 rows with middle DB failure and lost response; changed preview digest; over cap file.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-019
cases.description: Each filter+AND tags, empty set, multiline quote, formula-like contacts, foreign/org request, >page export.

checks: All filtered owned rows match directory semantics, safe CSV does not execute formulas and private/excluded fields never appear; narrower import limits explained.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-020
cases.description: Each allowed prior stage vs advanced stage, retried event, failed audit, removed role/withdrawn commitment and launch date change.

checks: Only named conditional forward effects occur coherently once; no incidental regression or lost material revision.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-021
cases.description: Multi-role Person with former team/earned revoked training, typed contact versus delivered email, foreign/deleted/merged Person.

checks: Tab sag ree with current own ing projections and history, no duplicated person denominator or false email delivery/privacy expansion.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-022
cases.description: Ask for noop source helper, save interview next steps, explicit reviewed follow-up draft/creation.

checks: No silent automation or false completion; actual shared task/follow-up operation works when explicitly reviewed.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-023
cases.description: At October 13 asOf, P moved prospect→at ten dee twice after a backward move, Q once, R is currently prospect but outside the September transition window, and S is retired/merged. Compare reconstructed September source cohort with missing original cohort history, plus foreign tenant request.

checks: Distinct current stage counts and September transition count use different labelled units; repeated P counts once, retired/merged source counts once through canonical history, missing denominator gives Unknown and foreign request refuses. No widget/tool is registered.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-024
cases.description: Register a later attendance and training consumer after WP-015; race its insert against source→survivor merge and Person retirement, then inspect every actual Person FK and inverse policy.

checks: Each reference is registered, same-tenant and either committed on the live survivor or refused; no later source reference escapes merge. Consumer closes only after its own fixtures, whole-target closure audits the complete schema.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-025
cases.description: Merge unlinked duplicate S into linked survivor D with distinct tags/qualification/household/photo and registered later refs; replay; safely reverse unchanged result. Then separately edit D, add training/RSVP, chain-merge or dispatch recorded mail before attempting inverse.

checks: Unchanged proven merge reverses all recorded effects with new receipt and intact original history. Each later conflict is named and refuses all inverse writes; manual reviewed correction preserves later facts, authority and author identity.

cases.requirement: REQ-PPL-026
cases.description: 30 known adults plus 1 unknown; newest genuine entrant joined yesterday then with drew; earlier invalid first occurrence corrected; same adult rejoined; September 1 signature entered October 9; clock 20/21/27/28 day boundaries.

checks: Known≥30 lower bound can meet with partial exact count; withdrawal shrinks size while genuine clock stays yesterday, invalid correction recomputes, rejoin does not reset, recording date is irrelevant and uncertainty remains visible.
